title: Emergency Brake Switch
summary: A safety-critical control that requests emergency braking.
purpose: Initiate an emergency-braking response for abnormal situations that require urgent deceleration.
observations: An emergency-brake-active indication is displayed when the emergency request is accepted.
Train speed should decrease over time; an emergency command does not instantly stop a moving train.
Traction may be inhibited while the emergency state remains active.
interactions: Identify the separate emergency brake switch.
Observe the emergency state and speedometer response during a practice exercise.
Discuss why reset must follow applicable train-specific instructions.
safetyNotes: Emergency braking is not used as a substitute for routine service braking.
The teaching exercise permits reset at standstill with N selected; this is not a universal railway procedure.
